# ShiftHub — Error Notifier

Global safety net. Set this workflow as the Error Workflow on every ShiftHub workflow (Settings → Error Workflow) so any failure emails + Telegrams the supervisor with the workflow name, node and error.

A silently failing reminder workflow is how shifts get missed — this makes failures loud.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when any workflow that names this as its error workflow fails.

nodes.name: Format Error
nodes.notes: Builds a readable alert from the error payload.

nodes.name: Email Supervisor (Error)
nodes.notes: SMTP send (Gmail app password). All ShiftHub mails go from the facility mailbox.

nodes.name: Telegram Supervisor (Error)
nodes.notes: Best-effort Telegram notification; failure does not stop the run.
